title: Restriction of an integer multiplicity current to a Borel set: integrability, representation, mass and vanishing set
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ and R = (M, θ, ξ) an IMRep in univ of degree k. (A) For every k-form β on ℝ^P that is a test form (IsTestForm: smooth with compact support), x ↦ θ(x)·ξ(x)(β(x)) is H^k-integrable on M. (B) If X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P) is represented by R, F ⊆ ℝ^P is closed, X vanishes off F (X(ω) = 0 whenever tsupport ω ∩ F = ∅) and B ⊆ ℝ^P is Borel, then there is an integer multiplicity Y ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P) with Y(ω) = ∫_{M∩B} θ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dH^k for every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^P), M(Y) = μ_R(B), and Y(ω) = 0 whenever tsupport ω ∩ (F ∩ B) = ∅.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k), (∀ β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k, IsTestForm β → IntegrableOn (fun x => (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x (β x)) R.carrier μHE[k]) ∧ ∀ (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k) (F B : Set (Euclid P)), R.Represents X → IsClosed F → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k)) (F) → X ω = 0) → MeasurableSet B → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, IsIntegerMultiplicity Y ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, Y ω = ∫ x in R.carrier ∩ B, (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μHE[k]) ∧ Y.mass = R.measure B ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k)) (F ∩ B) → Y ω = 0
